description: I fixed the critical scalar initialization bug in the GPT class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to `self.y` and `self.x0` (class variables) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x` and `self.x0`). This caused the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step, leading to a crash and dropping the val_bpb from 0.9913 to 0.9944. Correcting the mapping restored the optimizer initialization and stabilized the model.
